title: REDMAGIC 11 Pro (6.85" AMOLED 144Hz, 12GB/256GB, Snapdragon 8 Elite) $849.32 Delivered @ REDMAGIC Direct via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: REDMAGIC 11 Pro (6.85" AMOLED 144Hz, 12GB/256GB, Snapdragon 8 Elite) $849.32 Delivered @ REDMAGIC Direct via Amazon AU

[RichardL] So apparently there's 2 variant of the RedMagic 11 Pro.
Global/International Model
China Model
Differences - Different back, battery, peak brightness & wireless charging, etc.
The Amazon listing uses a mixture of both images, so not sure which one you'll receive
[Lenzi] Appears to be the Global version as the Amazon spec sheet states wireless charging and 7500 mAh battery.
[deangalanoz] The Global / International Model also has that design called Matte Black Cryo
Look at the first phone. It's the same back.
[angelkulit025] ugghh 256gb, hope there are bigger options for storage.
[HaydosK] Why? I have all the games I need + normal phone stuff on 128gb.
[angelkulit025] i'm on 240gb out of 512gb ROG Phone 7. Mobile games these days with high graphics requires a lot of storage space.
[angelkulit025] @SlowCarSlow: https://imgur.com/a/zDcMQZu
[bheart] 2 Generations of Android OS Updates and 3 years security updates is the deal breaker for me
https://global.redmagic.gg/pages/software-update-policy
[Some Random Guy] Damn all those hackers hacking into those android 8/9/10/11/12/13/14/15 phones is a crisis!
Someone call a royal commission into this NOW!
FYI this is a joke. I'm technically minded and installed so many unofficial ROMs from the XDA forums (and telegram) and I never had an issue with security.
I have absolutely no clue how companies have spooked people into believing they require "the latest security". Like the latest android releases are literally blocking you from downloading FOSS apps…
[Dannywce] Will this one get cooked by vodafone as well?
